content:
Attachment: Effort Certification Procedures Manual.pdf
Downloadable file attached to the ORA eTraining module "Show Your Work: Understanding Time and Effort Reporting", lesson "Effort Reporting at MSU".
Source: https://articulateusercontent.com/rise/courses/pBBHPT8z6JjgtlDKPVWpUIJpK3eOxKQQ/4XOKYJZHWbMT775J.pdf

PROCEDURE TO CERTIFY EFFORT
This document describes the procedure to certify effort by individuals in one of the following
roles: employees, principle investigators, program directors, chairs, deans, and alternate using the
SearchLight Performance Assessment platform.
STEP 1A: START PROCESS THROUGH EMAIL
• During an active certification period, you will receive an email that list all the effort you
are required to certify as one of the 6 roles given above
• Click on the Certify button in the email to begin the certification process OR to
report an issue that prevents you from certification the listed efforts
STEP 1B: START PROCESS ON SEARCHLIGHT PA
• Login to your SearchLight PA account at, searchlightpa.com (if you do not remember your
password, click the “Reset It Here” link on the login page)
• If you have uncertified effort reports, a red banner will be displayed at the top of the page
• Click this banner to begin the certification process
STEP 2: REVIEW EFFORT ALLOCATION
• On the “Confirm Effort Allocation” panel review the information presented for correctness
• You may click the button to access Bi-Weekly Payroll records aid in effort
certification

STEP 3: CERTIFY OR REPORT ISSUE
• If there are no issues to report, check the records you wish to certify (click the checkbox
next to “Payroll” to check all records), then click the “Certify” button
• If there are issues to report, check the records for which you wish to report issues (click
the checkbox next to “Payroll” to check all records), then click the “Report an Issue”
checkbox, describe the nature of the issue preventing certification, then click the “Report
Issue” button
